profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Teacher Assistant for CS179 - GPU Programming
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented new homework set on using Cublas and CuSolver for point alignment
• Instructed lectures on GPU memory optimization, machine learning, and CuDNN

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented code generation from AI graph model to Brainwave compiler intermediate representation
• Captured control flow of AI graph and FPGA-supported vector and matrix operations
• Facilitated fast prototyping of graph models to be used in Brainwave runtime making FPGA accessible to all AI developers and data scientists

positions.title: IT Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Participated in the development of ZConnect, the Android and iOS mobile apps that facilitate the communication between injured worker and examiner
• Implemented the mock-up of activity tracker and achievements as a gamification idea using Android Studio and built-in accelerometer
• Efficiently identified and resolved issues related to ZConnect by detecting bugs and enhancing existing features
• Collaborated with fellow interns to create a website documenting our internship experience at
Zenith using WordPress

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher in the Hsieh Research Group
positions.description:
•	Improved efficiency in data analyzation by developing a MatLab program dedicated to organizing experimental data and displaying observable trends across multiple experiments
•	Engineered a new pump-probe spectroscopy setup with adjustable probe laser pulses

positions.title: Winter Intern
positions.description: • Collaborated with Provider & Network Management team to survey medical providers and deliver better telehealth service for the injured workers.

honors.title: Class Netflix Challenge Winner
honors.description:
• Implemented neural autoregressive approach to collaborative filtering (CF-NADE) to model and predict user rating vector on set of movies
• Improved rating prediction accuracy to 4.6% above original Netflix model with CF-NADE model
• Blended CF-NADE with TimeSVD++, RBM, Tensor Factorization, and other machine learning models reaching 8.86% test improvement from original Netflix model
honors.issuer: Issued by CS156B: Learning Systems · Jun 2018

volunteerExperiences.description: Spreading Sprouts is an organization aimed at cultivating the minds of young students through creating organic gardens in elementary schools across the Los Angeles County. In creating these gardens we hope to foster a passion for science, technology, engineering, the arts, and math. As the president of this club, I organized events with local elementary schools as well as encouraged fellow high school students to participate and interact with elementary school students.

organizations.name: Phelps Forward For Grads
organizations.description:
Phelps Forward career development program for first-generation college graduates, all women, working in the field of tech.

Completed full college-level PF career development program in 2019.

organizations.name: Phelps Forward
organizations.description: Selected to participate in cutting edge career development program for first generation college women with outstanding business leadership potential in the area of technology. Phelps Forward serves top US college students and graduates pursuing careers in tech and finance by providing career development and networking guidance, then connecting them to a dynamic group of partner employers.
